name: healthfit
description: Personal comprehensive health management system integrating Western medicine and TCM. Triggers when users discuss workout training plans, nutrition advice, health data tracking, TCM constitution identification, solar term wellness, tongue diagnosis, or sexual health records. Provides four advisors (Coach Alex - Fitness Coach / Dr. Mei - Nutritionist / Analyst Ray - Data Analyst / Dr. Chen - TCM Wellness Practitioner), supporting in-depth profiling and long-term tracking. Triggers on requests like "create my profile", "log today's workout", "my constitution", "thick white tongue coating".
